description.en: Per-workspace DSH conversation status in the Windows system tray and native DeepSeek Harness notifications for waiting, completed and failed conversations, with a live Tray follower settings page. Idle conversations are hidden by default; the tray bridge is optional and installed once from the package with a reversible user-level script.
description.zh: 在 Windows 系统托盘里按工作区显示 DSH 对话状态，并在等待人工介入、完成或失败时由 DeepSeek Harness 应用本身发出原生通知；另含「托盘跟随」设置页，9 项设置实时生效。空闲对话默认隐藏；托盘桥接为可选项，通过包内脚本一次性安装，用户级、可卸载。
